questions.q: What does running a BI Publisher report "on demand" typically involve?
options: Editing the data model's source code directly
Supplying the report's parameters, picking an output format, and running it manually
Waiting for Oracle to run it automatically with no user input ever
Building a brand-new subject area each time
questions.explain: Running on demand means a user supplies the defined parameters and output format, similar in spirit to setting a point of view for a Financial Reporting Studio report.

questions.q: What is required for a BI Publisher report to run unattended on a schedule?
options: Nothing extra; all reports run unattended by default
A job definition that registers it to be submitted through the Scheduled Processes work area
Converting it into an OTBI analysis first
Manual approval from Oracle support each time
questions.explain: A job definition is what allows a specific report definition to be submitted and scheduled through Scheduled Processes.

questions.q: What underlying engine actually executes a scheduled BI Publisher report at its specified times?
options: The BI Presentation Catalog
Oracle's Enterprise Scheduler Service (ESS)
Financial Reporting Web Studio
The Account Groups Sunburst engine
questions.explain: Enterprise Scheduler Service (ESS) is the scheduling engine behind recurring, unattended BI Publisher report execution.

questions.q: Why might a close-related report be scheduled for "the second business day of every month" rather than simply "daily"?
options: Because ESS cannot run jobs more than once a month
To wait until relevant subledgers have closed before the report's numbers would be meaningful
Because BI Publisher reports can only run on business days
There is no reason; this pattern is never used
questions.explain: Custom recurrence patterns let a report wait for dependencies, such as subledger close, before it makes sense to run.

questions.q: Which of the following is a typical delivery option for a scheduled BI Publisher report's output?
options: Emailing the output directly to recipients
Deleting the report definition automatically after one run
Converting it permanently into a Smart View Report Package
Disabling all future runs of the same report
questions.explain: Typical delivery options include saving to a shared location, emailing directly to recipients, and printing — sometimes more than one at once.
